title: Desk display

panels.title: Indoor
panels.description: Room temperature from the BME280 on the display. Comfortable: 20-24 °C (green). Below 18 blue, above 25 orange, above 28 red.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor" and r._field == "temp_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < 18.0 then "Cold" else if x[0] < 20.0 then "Cool" else if x[0] < 25.0 then "Comfortable" else if x[0] < 28.0 then "Warm" else "Hot"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Indoor relative humidity. Comfortable: 40-60 % (green). Below 30 % dry air (orange): dry eyes/throat. Above 60 % yellow, above 70 % red: mould risk, time to air the room.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor" and r._field == "humidity")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < 30.0 then "Dry" else if x[0] < 40.0 then "A bit dry" else if x[0] < 60.0 then "Comfortable" else if x[0] < 70.0 then "Humid" else "Too humid"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Air pressure in hPa, measured in the room (same as outside). Reads about 4 hPa below weather reports: those are converted to sea level, Berlin is ~35 m up. Rough guide (weather-report values): under 1000 low, unsettled, rain and wind likely; 1010-1020 normal; above 1025 high, settled, dry. The word on the tile uses those, shifted down 4 hPa. The trend matters more than the value: see Pressure 3h.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor" and r._field == "pressure_hpa")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < 996.0 then "Low" else if x[0] < 1021.0 then "Normal" else "High"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Pressure 3h
panels.description: Pressure change over the last 3 hours. Falling more than 3 hPa (orange/red): weather getting worse, rain or wind coming. Rising more than 3 hPa (blue): clearing up. Within ±1: no change.

targets.query:
raw = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: -3h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor" and r._field == "pressure_hpa")
data = union(tables: [raw |> first(), raw |> last()])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference()
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < -6.0 then "Falling fast" else if x[0] < -3.0 then "Falling" else if x[0] < -1.0 then "Falling a bit" else if x[0] < 1.0 then "Steady" else if x[0] < 3.0 then "Rising a bit" else "Rising"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Outdoor
panels.description: Current outdoor temperature and weather in central Berlin (Open-Meteo), refreshed every 15 min.

targets.query:
import "dict"
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "outdoor" and r._field == "temp_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
code = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "outdoor" and r._field == "weather_code")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: code) == 0 then "" else dict.get(dict: [0: "Clear", 1: "Mostly clear", 2: "Partly cloudy", 3: "Overcast", 45: "Fog", 48: "Fog", 51: "Drizzle", 53: "Drizzle", 55: "Drizzle", 56: "Freezing drizzle", 57: "Freezing drizzle", 61: "Light rain", 63: "Rain", 65: "Heavy rain", 66: "Freezing rain", 67: "Freezing rain", 71: "Light snow", 73: "Snow", 75: "Heavy snow", 77: "Snow grains", 80: "Showers", 81: "Showers", 82: "Heavy showers", 85: "Snow showers", 86: "Snow showers", 95: "Thunderstorm", 96: "Thunderstorm, hail", 99: "Thunderstorm, hail"], key: int(v: code[0]), default: "")
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: AQI
panels.description: European Air Quality Index for Berlin (Open-Meteo, refreshed every 15 min). 0-20 good, 20-40 fair (green), 40-60 moderate (yellow), 60-80 poor (orange), 80-100 very poor (red), above 100 extremely poor (purple).

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air" and r._field == "aqi")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < 20.0 then "Good" else if x[0] < 40.0 then "Fair" else if x[0] < 60.0 then "Moderate" else if x[0] < 80.0 then "Poor" else if x[0] < 100.0 then "Very poor" else "Extremely poor"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: WiFi signal
panels.description: WiFi signal strength at the display, in dBm: closer to 0 is stronger. -30 to -50 excellent, -50 to -67 good (green); -67 to -80 weak, occasional slow requests (orange); below -80 poor, dropouts (red). Useful when fetches fail or after moving the display.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "rssi")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < -80.0 then "Poor" else if x[0] < -67.0 then "Weak" else if x[0] < -50.0 then "Good" else "Excellent"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Display
panels.description: Online while the display uploads (every 60 s). No upload for 3 min: shows how long it has been off. Graphs have a gap there, and a marker where it came back (Display restarted).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "uptime_s")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with level: if r._value < 180.0 then "Display" else "Offline for"}))
  |> group(columns: ["level"])

x = data |> last() |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
level = if length(arr: x) == 0 then "" else if x[0] < 800.0 then "Fresh" else if x[0] < 1000.0 then "Fine" else if x[0] < 1400.0 then "Stuffy" else "Open a window"
data |> set(key: "level", value: level)
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "level"])

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the display last restarted. Drops to zero after a reset: normal after flashing or unplugging, otherwise a crash or a power problem (check the boot log for BROWNOUT). Each restart is a marker on the graphs.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "uptime_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Display health. WiFi dBm (left axis): see the WiFi tile. Free heap (right axis): memory left on the ESP32; ~150-190 KB is normal, a steady decline over days would mean a memory leak.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "rssi")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "heap_free_kb")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

target.query:
from(bucket: "desk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device" and r._field == "uptime_s")
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "up")
  |> difference()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - int(v: r.up) * 1000000000), text: "Display restarted"}))
